svg.title: Inference cost, security & involuntary-churn guardrails
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-05-token-and-churn-guardrail-tree; chart type: decision_tree; title: Inference cost, security & involuntary-churn guardrails; subtitle: Mandatory production checks before opening public signups; chapter number: 5; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Numbers identify engineering gates; enforce in middleware before any upstream LLM call.; caption: Prevent weekend token-bill blowups and cross-tenant leaks through hard Redis budgets, RLS isolation, ZDR endpoints, and smart dunning.; stages: label: Tenant RLS & cap?; value: Node 1; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Enforce Postgres tenant_id RLS and hard daily/monthly Redis token ceilings before inference.; label: Cache or small model?; value: Node 2; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Serve repeat queries from cache and route structured extraction to low-cost models first.; label: ZDR & eval pass?; value: Node 3; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Call Zero-Data-Retention enterprise endpoints and block deploys that regress golden evals.; label: Smart dunning live?; value: Node 4; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Run card-updater, pre-expiry alerts, and multi-day retry cadences to cut involuntary churn.
